alert: p99 latency above 5s, Redis connections at 100%
logs: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Too many connections | pool exhausted, 10/10 in use
root_cause: Redis connection pool size of 10 too low for peak traffic
fix_steps: Raised REDIS_POOL_SIZE from 10 to 50 and rolled restart of checkout pods

alert: 5xx error rate above 15% right after deploy v2.14.0
logs: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers | NullPointerException at PaymentMapper.java:88
root_cause: Release v2.14.0 introduced a null currency field bug
fix_steps: Rolled back to v2.13.2 with kubectl rollout undo, then opened a hotfix ticket

alert: Disk usage 98% on node logs-02, pods evicted
logs: No space left on device | /var/log/app.log size 71GB
root_cause: Debug logging left on after last incident and no log rotation
fix_steps: Truncated oldest logs, set log level to INFO, enabled logrotate with 7-day retention

alert: Checkout timeouts, Redis connection errors during flash sale
logs: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Too many connections | pool exhausted, 50/50 in use
root_cause: Pool of 50 still too small during flash sale, plus leaked connections in the cart handler
fix_steps: Raised pool to 120 and patched cart handler to release connections in a finally block

alert: Order writes timing out, Postgres lock waits above 30s
logs: ERROR: canceling statement due to lock timeout | blocked by pid 2291 UPDATE orders SET status
root_cause: Long-running backfill query held row locks on the orders table
fix_steps: Terminated pid 2291 with pg_terminate_backend, rescheduled backfill to off-peak in batches of 1000

alert: Search latency above 8s, Redis connections at 100%
logs: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Too many connections | 10/10 in use | blocked on SCAN with pattern query:*
root_cause: Unknown at the time, suspected pool size like checkout-service
fix_steps: Raised REDIS_POOL_SIZE from 10 to 50 and restarted pods

alert: Search latency still above 8s after pool increase, Redis CPU at 95%
logs: slowlog: SCAN 0 MATCH query:* COUNT 100000 took 4200ms | 600k keys with no TTL
root_cause: Query cache keys had no TTL and a wildcard SCAN ran on every request, so pool size was never the problem
fix_steps: Added 1h TTL to query cache keys, replaced SCAN with a keyed lookup, flushed stale keys

alert: Payment failures spiking right after deploy v2.16.1
logs: upstream connect error | 503 from fraud-check | config key FRAUD_API_URL missing
root_cause: New release expected FRAUD_API_URL env var that was missing in production config
fix_steps: Rolled back to v2.16.0, then added FRAUD_API_URL to the production config map before redeploy

alert: p99 latency above 6s, Redis connections maxed out
logs: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Too many connections | pool exhausted, 120/120 in use
root_cause: Connection leak returned in the new coupon handler
fix_steps: Hot-patched coupon handler to close connections, restarted pods, left pool at 120

logs: No space left on device | /var/log/audit.log size 54GB
root_cause: Audit log rotation job silently failing since a cron path change
fix_steps: Fixed logrotate cron path, forced rotation, added a disk-usage alert at 80%

logs: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid | not after: 2026-10-14T00:00:00Z
root_cause: Internal TLS certificate expired, auto-renewal job was disabled
fix_steps: Issued a new cert, reloaded the auth pods, re-enabled cert-manager renewal
